device_configuration.label: Configure devices
device_configuration.next: Deploy or repair the configuration profile or security feature this setting checks, then confirm on one affected device before rolling out.

user_action.label: Ask users
user_action.next: Tell the affected users what to change, or enforce it with an update ring or policy, and set a deadline that matches the grace period.

policy_assignment.label: Fix policy
policy_assignment.next: Check which compliance policies target these devices and resolve missing assignments or conflicting settings.

stale_or_orphaned.label: Clean up devices
stale_or_orphaned.next: Confirm the devices are no longer in use, then retire them or reconnect their owners. These devices will not report a fix until they check in.

security_investigation.label: Investigate risk
security_investigation.next: Send these devices to whoever owns endpoint security; the setting reports a risk signal rather than a configuration gap.

other.label: Review
other.next: Read the setting definition in the compliance policy and decide who owns the fix.

jev_question.instructions: `cause` describes one Microsoft Intune compliance setting that is failing on managed devices. `cause.setting` is the setting identifier; custom compliance settings can have any name. Which remediation path usually resolves this setting?

device_configuration.what: An admin deploys or repairs device configuration or a security feature

user_action.what: The device user must act on the device

policy_assignment.what: The compliance policy itself is missing, mis-targeted or conflicting

stale_or_orphaned.what: The device stopped checking in or its user no longer exists
stale_or_orphaned.not_for: Devices that report in normally but fail a setting

security_investigation.what: The setting reports a security risk signal that needs investigation
